notes: One schema covers every verified tag: all struct changes across them are additive with serde defaults, so a response valid for 0.148.0 is valid for 0.153.4 and vice versa as far as the client's rejection rules go.

rust-v0.150.0: ConfigShellToolType collapsed from five variants (default, local, unified_exec, disabled, shell_command) to unified_exec | disabled with the other three as aliases of unified_exec — same accepted spellings.
rust-v0.151.0: ModelInfo gained multi_agent_reasoning_effort; ModelMessages gained persistent_instructions and confirmation_policies; ReasoningEffort gained persistent.
rust-v0.153.1 and rust-v0.153.4: openai_models.rs byte-identical to each other; no struct changes since 0.152.0.

rust-v0.154.0: ModelInfo gained guardian (GuardianModelPolicy) and supports_experimental_context. openai_models.rs now declares submodules under openai_models/ (guardian.rs, reasoning_effort.rs; guardian_v2.rs has existed since 0.149.0); snapshots vendor them from this tag on.
rust-v0.155.0 and rust-v0.155.1: sources byte-identical to rust-v0.154.0 (snapshot_aliases).

rust-v0.156.0: ModelInfo gained available_access_programs (ModelAccessPrograms; `cyber` is required when the object is present) and supports_reasoning_effort_updates. ModelMessages.tools gained multi_agent; ToolMessage gained parameters. GuardianModelPolicy dropped code_mode and gained other_tools, unscored_action, initial_cua_call and sandboxed_exec_commands. Personality selection was removed: supports_personality is always false and instructions_variables is deprecated (still decoded). config_types.rs: comment-only change.

rust-v0.158.0: ModelMessages.tools gained indirect_description_prefixes and mcp_resources; tools.multi_agent gained the channel tools (create_channel … post). rust-v0.159.0 … rust-v0.159.3: byte-identical to rust-v0.158.0.
rust-v0.160.0: ModelMessages gained content_filter_guidance. rust-v0.160.1: byte-identical.
rust-v0.161.0: GuardianV2ModelConfig gained async_classifier_mode (closed enum: snapshot | conversation) and async_classifier_conversation_token_limit; ModelAccessPrograms gained helper methods only.
Tags after rust-v0.153.4 are vendored by scripts/sync-codex-tags.mjs: a tag whose sources are byte-identical to the previous snapshot is recorded in snapshot_aliases instead of stored again.

Every stored snapshot keeps the client's own bundled catalog (codex-rs/models-manager/models.json at that tag) as a test vector; validate.mjs checks the schema against all of them. The catalogs carry keys the struct does not have (supports_parallel_tool_calls, prefer_websockets, requires_sandboxed_review, supports_reasoning_summaries, available_in_plans, minimal_client_version); the client ignores them.
